courses.overview: 從核心協作、併發機制與版本驗證延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend kernel collaboration, concurrency and version validation to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 軟體弱點管理流程
related.why: 版本、風險與迴歸測試原則共用
related.whyEn: Version, risk and regression principles transfer
related.transfer: 版本、風險與迴歸測試原則共用
related.transferEn: Version, risk and regression principles transfer
related.difference: 核心貢獻還需跨架構與併發審查
related.differenceEn: Kernel contributions add cross-architecture and concurrency review

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「軟體弱點管理流程」共用的資料／元件介面；以「版本、風險與迴歸測試原則共用」指出能保留的條件。
針對「核心貢獻還需跨架構與併發審查」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with software vulnerability-management workflows; use "Version, risk and regression principles transfer" to identify retained conditions.
For "Kernel contributions add cross-architecture and concurrency review", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 科學高效能計算排程
related.why: 任務與資源狀態影響系統執行
related.whyEn: Task and resource states affect execution
related.transfer: 任務與資源狀態影響系統執行
related.transferEn: Task and resource states affect execution
related.difference: 核心排程處理 CPU 時間，HPC 排程處理工作分配
related.differenceEn: Kernel scheduling handles CPU time; HPC scheduling allocates jobs

courses.summary: Linux 作業系統協作工程從核心協作、併發機制與版本驗證連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Linux operating-system collaborative engineering connects interfaces, data and acceptance through kernel collaboration, concurrency and version validation. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「貢獻邊界」到「維護交付」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect contribution boundaries to maintenance delivery, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: Linux 公開開發流程與排程文件呈現持續協作；CFS 與 EEVDF 分開說明，避免把歷史演算法寫成今日唯一實現。
history.textEn: Linux development and scheduler documents show ongoing collaboration; CFS and EEVDF are separated rather than presenting one historical algorithm as universal today.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.

roles.role: 旗下 Red Hat 為 Linux 核心長期主要貢獻者。
roles.roleEn: Its Red Hat unit is a long-time leading Linux-kernel contributor.
roles.business: 提供混合雲（Red Hat、Confluent）、大型主機、儲存與量子運算。
roles.businessEn: Offers hybrid cloud (Red Hat, Confluent), mainframes, storage and quantum computing.

roles.role: Linux 核心最大企業貢獻者之一。

roles.business: 設計與製造 x86 處理器、晶圓代工、網路與 AI 加速晶片。
roles.businessEn: Designs and manufactures x86 processors and runs a foundry, networking and AI-accelerator businesses.

courses.connection: 從「Linux 作業系統協作工程」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Linux operating-system collaborative engineering. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
